name: GetColumnNameOnExcelWorksheetNode
label: Get Column Name on Excel Worksheet
description: Gets the column letter name for a given column index in the specified Excel worksheet.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: ColumnIndex
fields.label: Column Index
fields.description: The 1-based column index to convert to a column letter name.

fields.name: ColumnName
fields.label: Column Name
fields.description: The letter name of the column (e.g., 'A', 'B', 'AA').
